text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT [INC-1736000000] polaris-prod (eu-west-1) dedicated pool — elevated 5xx rate detected affecting enterprise customer Polaris Finance. Automated paging triggered for on-call. Suggested immediate action: rollback last model rollout to v2.3-quant.

sania: taking the page, joining now. grabbing logs and traffic split.

elena-sre: seeing consistent 502/503 at infer-proxy -> model-worker. Error pattern looks like OOM/retry loop on the quantized variant (v2.3-quant) introduced during the 14:12 deploy. Memory spike aligns with KV cache growth.

mike: rollback to v2.2 (rev abc123) started: kubectl rollout undo deploy/model-serving --to-revision=abc123. ETA ~3m for pods to be ready. I'll monitor readiness and probe failures.

ops-bot: Deploy rollback initiated by mike at 1736000015. Notifying autoscaler to hold scale-down during the rollback.

jordan-cs: drafting customer notification for Polaris Finance (enterprise):
- short impact: "We are investigating elevated error rates (5xx) affecting API responses for reserved/dedicated instances. We have initiated an immediate rollback to a stable model to restore service."
- tailored impact: "Polaris Finance: generation and embeddings for reserved pool 'polaris-prod' may experience failed requests and increased latency. No user data was modified; requests may need to be retried."
- routing/contact: send to Polaris primary SRE (sre@polaris.example.com) and account exec (ae@polaris.example.com).

sania: LGTM — add an estimated restoration ETA: 15 minutes. Include escalation path: if not resolved in 30m, escalate to enterprise SRE oncall and prepare customer conference bridge. Also include link to status page and incident id.

elena-sre: confirmed rollback health checks passing on two pods, 1/3 still failing but logs show crashloop referencing quantized allocator. After the final pod is ready we should see 5xx rate drop.

mike: all pods on v2.2 ready at 1736000038. Observability: 5xx rate dropping from 6.4% -> 0.8% over last 60s. Continuing monitor for 15 minutes.

jordan-cs: status page entry (for ops copy):
- id: INC-1736000000
- severity: P1 (enterprise impact)
- summary: Elevated 5xx errors for Polaris Finance on dedicated pool in eu-west-1; rollback to stable model in progress.
- started: 1736000000 (UTC)
- current status: mitigation in progress, partial service restore observed; updates every 15 minutes.

ops-bot: oncall-handoff scheduled: initial oncall (sania) -> secondary (elena-sre) at +30m if incident persists. Paging suppressed for known receivers.

sania: drafting outgoing customer email now, will paste below for sign-off.
jordan-cs: paste when ready, I'll send once approved by sania/elena.

sania: EMAIL DRAFT (for Polaris SRE + AE):
Subject: Service Incident INC-1736000000 — degraded API responses for Polaris Finance (eu-west-1)
Body: Hello Polaris team, we detected an elevated rate of 5xx responses affecting your reserved pool (polaris-prod) in eu-west-1 starting at 14:12 UTC. Root cause appears to be a recent model variant rollout (v2.3-quant) that triggered memory pressure and retries. We initiated an immediate rollback to v2.2; rollback completed and service metrics indicate error rates declining. Next steps: we will monitor for 30 minutes and follow up with a full incident report. No customer data was modified. If you need a bridge or expedited postmortem, reply to this thread or contact our SE/AE.

elena-sre: Approved. Add troubleshooting note: "We traced the issue to allocator interactions with quantized kernels under specific batch sizes; we will block v2.3-quant for dedicated pools until mitigations land."

jordan-cs: sending now to Polaris SRE and AE. I'll also publish the status page update with the text above and link to this internal thread for ops timeline.

mike: monitoring after rollback, tailing logs. If any reappearance trigger, we'll open a mitigation runbook and consider fallback to warm standby cluster.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation acknowledged. Current status: partial restoration observed. Next update scheduled in 15 minutes or sooner if status changes.
